name: Brutalist
description: Raw, anti-decorative neo-brutalism defined by stark high-contrast boundaries, thick black borders, hard offset drop shadows, and monospace utility.
designPrinciples: Unapologetic raw functionality and anti-decorative honesty
Extreme contrast with harsh pure black and white surfaces
Acid green / neon high-voltage accent punctuation
Tactile physical presence via thick ink borders and solid offset shadows

guidelines: Monospace or ultra-bold industrial grotesque headings

layout.structure: Tightly packed modular grid with thick separating borders and sharp edges
layout.spacing: Dense, utilitarian padding (16px to 24px) maximizing information density
layout.alignment: Strict box-bound alignment with visible structural scaffolding
rules: Every major element container must feature a 3px to 5px solid #000000 border
Use hard offset shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #000000) with zero blur radius
Highlight interactive or important tags in high-visibility neon green #22C55E
Zero border-radius anywhere: all corners must be completely sharp (0px)

patternsToAvoid: Ethereal floating elements without rigid border enclosures
